scores.claim_text: Salomon employs patented proprietary footwear technologies (Sensifit, Contagrip, Quicklace) and Amer Sports brands rely on extensive product/technology IP across footwear, apparel and equipment.
scores.M_value: 101 granted patents pre-cutoff (158 total applications); applicant uniformly SALOMON S.A.S; category_counts footwear=120, ski=8. Footwear/sole/lacing/boot IP dominates exactly the claimed technology area.
scores.interpretation: USPTO independently corroborates a deep, on-point Salomon patent estate concentrated in footwear and ski equipment, matching the prospectus's patented-footwear-technology claims. Clean PASS; no Nikola pattern (large count but wrong area) here.

scores.claim_text: Wilson has driven product innovation across football, baseball, tennis and golf for over a century, with patented basketball/ball technologies.
scores.M_value: 377 granted patents pre-cutoff across the over-broad 'Wilson' token (includes unrelated Wilson Tool, Wilson Electronics, Wilson Wolf). The on-point subset is real: applicant 'Wilson Sporting Goods Co.' appears with SPORTS GLOVE patents (e.g. 12302966, granted) and category_counts ball/racquet=87.
scores.interpretation: Name-token is over-broad so the raw 377 cannot be taken at face value, but the relevant Wilson Sporting Goods entity is affirmatively present with ball/glove/racquet IP. Sporting-goods product innovation claim is corroborated at the entity level; severity PASS with the caveat that the count is not entirely attributable to the brand.

scores.claim_text: Arc'teryx holds proprietary technical-apparel product IP (Alpha SV jacket construction, climbing harness designs, trail footwear).
scores.M_value: USPTO: 0 applications/0 granted under 'Arcteryx' spelling (name-variant fragility; Arc'teryx IP is likely held under the parent/Salomon S.A.S or filed as design/trade-dress, and the prospectus describes design innovation rather than asserting a granted-patent count). EDGAR FTS: 7 filings mention 'Arcteryx' incl. Simon Property Group 10-K (mall landlord) and On Holding / Canada Goose, independently confirming the brand's real retail presence.
scores.interpretation: The prospectus makes a design-innovation claim, not a quantified granted-patent claim, for Arc'teryx, and the brand is a registered trade name not necessarily an USPTO assignee. Zero patents under one spelling is a benign name-variant miss, not underdelivery. Brand existence is independently corroborated by counterparty (landlord/competitor) filings. Scored UNVERIFIABLE — no registry cleanly covers the specific claim, but no contradiction.

scores.claim_text: ANTA Sports Products Limited is a significant-influence owner of Amer Sports and a related-party counterparty (purchases/sales of goods between the two).
scores.M_value: 'Amer Sports' = 33 US filings (Peloton re Precor divestiture, Vista Outdoor, Slinger Bag) — corroborates Amer Sports as a real externally-referenced entity. 'ANTA' = 86 hits but the token is a substring (matches Antares Pharma, etc.), so it does NOT cleanly isolate ANTA Sports. ANTA Sports Products Limited is HK-listed (HKEX 2020), not a US SEC filer, so US EDGAR cannot corroborate the ownership relationship.
scores.interpretation: Foreign-issuer caveat (calibration #2): ANTA Sports is a Hong Kong issuer outside US registry coverage, so absence of clean US-filing corroboration is expected and is NOT a contradiction. The ownership/related-party disclosure is internally consistent (audited related-party note shows modest intercompany goods flows, $8.6M purchases / $1.9M sales in 2022). UNVERIFIABLE via US registries; no red flag.

scores.claim_text: Arc'teryx and Salomon co-develop new GORE-TEX membranes with Gore-Tex for jackets and footwear.
scores.M_value: W. L. Gore & Associates (Gore-Tex) is a privately held company and not an SEC filer, so no counterparty disclosure exists to corroborate a co-development arrangement. No US registry covers a private-supplier materials partnership.
scores.interpretation: Supplier/co-development relationship with a private materials company is not recorded in any federal registry and the counterparty does not file with the SEC (calibration #5/#8: do not manufacture severity). Honestly scored UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Amer Sports operates a global physical footprint of over 330 owned retail stores (24 countries) and 19 distribution centers (operates 9) as of September 30, 2023.
scores.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities (sector-registry mismatch — not run as a hard contradiction test)
scores.M_value: EPA FRS covers US-regulated INDUSTRIAL/emitting facilities; retail stores and apparel distribution centers do not register, and Amer Sports's footprint is overwhelmingly non-US (Cayman inc / Finland ops; only 42% Americas revenue, stores across 24 countries). No US registry enumerates branded retail stores or foreign DCs.
scores.interpretation: Wrong-registry-for-sector plus foreign-issuer caveat (calibration #1 and #2): EPA FRS is not the registry for retail/distribution real estate, and most facilities are outside the US. Absence is expected and not underdelivery. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Arc'teryx loyalty program had over 1.7 million members in Greater China as of September 30, 2023 (grown from ~14,000 in 2018).
scores.M_value: A China-market loyalty-program member count is not recorded in any US federal registry and no SEC-filing counterparty would disclose it. This is a self-reported operational metric for a foreign-market brand.
scores.interpretation: Membership counts (like SaaS ARR / neobank members) are not in any registry (calibration #8). Foreign-market metric, US registries do not cover. UNVERIFIABLE; not manufactured into severity.

scores.claim_text: The Company restated its FY2022/2021/2020 financials to correct misstatements and is highly levered (~EUR 2bn institutional term loan + ~EUR 4bn related-party shareholder loans), with recurring net losses and reliance on a EUR315m RCF.
scores.M_check: Internal financial-statement disclosure (audited KPMG report + MD&A in the 424B4); going-concern read from prospectus.
scores.M_value: Auditor (KPMG AB) report explicitly states FY2020-2022 statements were RESTATED to correct misstatements. Recurring net losses: -252.7 (2022), -126.3 (2021), -237.2 (2020); -113.9 nine-mo 2023. Total debt ~EUR 6bn incl. EUR ~4bn related-party shareholder loans (to be equitized/repaid at IPO) + EUR 1.7bn term loan. As of Sep-30-2023 only EUR 4.3M available under the RCF; negative equity for most of the period (deficit -73.9 at YE2022).
scores.interpretation: These are honestly and prominently DISCLOSED negatives (restatement, leverage, losses), not concealed — consistent with the honesty-alpha framework (disclosed bad news is not a lie). The IPO is structured to deleverage via shareholder-loan equitization and proceeds repayment. Scored MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY to flag the genuine balance-sheet stress and prior-period restatement as a real risk surfaced by the filing, while recognizing full disclosure (no contradiction, no concealment -> not SEVERE/RED).
